preview.author: Matt Jones

pick.text: Barcelona to win and over 2.5 goals seems the value pick for this game given the superb form Barcelona have shown of late.

preview.synopsis: First meeting between Sabah and a Spanish club, and Barcelona's first with an Azerbaijani one. Writer picks Barcelona to win and over 2.5 goals.

strengths.home: Ended a five-game winless run with a 5-1 league win over Sumqayit after a 4-1 loss to Viking; outside the top 24; McCarthy suspended (sent off against Viking).
strengths.away: Superb recent form; Andreas Christensen still missing.

preview.author: John Pennington

pick.text: Slavia Prague’s UCL games this season have produced an average of 3.5 goals per game and Villarreal’s 5.5, suggesting that backing over 3.5 total goals could be the way to go.

preview.synopsis: Slavia's UCL games average 3.5 goals and Villarreal's 5.5. Writer picks over 3.5 total goals (no outcome covered).

strengths.home: Czech record 19 European games without a win; 2-1 loss to Arsenal, D1 L3 in the league phase; strong domestic form; Chytil scores early, trips to Bayern and Porto still to come.
strengths.away: Unbeaten in both earlier meetings (W1 D1, won 2-0 in 2017/18); Mikautadze scored in two of his last three UCL games.

fixtures.competition: AFC Champions League Two League Phase
AFC Champions League Two League Phase

preview.synopsis: West Brom won the last meeting 2-0 at Bolton (first since January 2019) and are the stronger side. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 17th on 18 points (21-30), 1-1 with Portsmouth, one win in five; big-chance conversion 2nd worst; Erhahon and McAtee out.
strengths.away: Fifth on 29 points (25-17), 2-2 with Swansea, seven unbeaten; xG 1.78 per match; Collyer and Galves out.

preview.synopsis: Burnley won two and drew three of the last five meetings, averaging 3.6 goals; Birmingham are far better placed. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 22nd on 11 points (24-33), 2-2 with Blackburn, eight home games without a win; Bruun Larsen out, Laurent and Roberts suspended.
strengths.away: Fourth on 29 points (28-15), lost 0-1 to Stoke but three wins in the previous five.

preview.synopsis: The last meeting was a 1-1 draw. Blackburn arrive in better shape against a Watford side with the worst attack. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 21st on 15 points (13-27), lost 0-4 at Sheffield United, one win in five; xG 0.94, fewest touches in the box; Toth out.
strengths.away: 13th on 22 points (24-25), 2-2 at Burnley; Alebiosu out; strong big-chance conversion.

preview.synopsis: Stoke are on a strong run against a Millwall side that has lost three in a row; Stoke have won none of the last five meetings. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Second on 32 points (level with leaders), beat Birmingham 1-0, six unbeaten; Bombino suspended, Cisse out.
strengths.away: 16th on 18 points (23-28), three straight defeats after 0-1 to QPR; Sturge suspended, Leonard out.

preview.author: Chris Wilson

pick.text: Viking tend to score on the road in Europe, and with Atl Madrid not in the best of form at this stage, backing both teams to score could be the safest pick.

preview.synopsis: Atletico won all six earlier matches against Norwegian sides before losing to Bodo/Glimt last season. Writer picks both teams to score (no outcome covered).

strengths.home: Beat Getafe 3-0 after two losses; four points from four UCL rounds; Romero missed the weekend.
strengths.away: Tripic involved in five of Viking's nine UCL goals; tend to score on the road in Europe.

preview.author: Peter Stavrinou

pick.text: All signs point towards a goal-fest here, and so backing both teams to score 2+ goals catches the eye.

preview.synopsis: Brugge have won one of 20 against English clubs. Writer expects a goal-fest and picks both teams to score 2+ goals (no outcome covered).

strengths.home: Ten wins and a draw in 11 since losing 3-2 to Aston Villa; beat Inter, Lens and PSV in the league phase; Virgili doubt.
strengths.away: Won 13 of 17 against Belgian sides; Szoboszlai scored on his return from injury.

preview.author: Sridhar Bhamidi

pick.text: Inter’s strong recent record at San Siro and Stuttgart’s poor form in Italy pave the way for a home win.

preview.synopsis: First meeting. Inter are unbeaten in their last three UCL games against German clubs. Writer backs a home win.

strengths.home: Drew 4-4 at Atalanta, won six of last eight, back-to-back UCL clean sheets; Lautaro Martinez back; Calhanoglu forced off injured.
strengths.away: Poor record in Italy; one win in last nine against Italian clubs.

preview.author: Ryan Fisher

pick.text: Bayern Munich have been slow starters in this competition and considering their blunted attack, a half-time draw is certainly worth looking at here.

preview.synopsis: Bayern won both earlier meetings (2012); Lille have won two of their last 11 against German sides. Writer picks a half-time draw.

strengths.home: Lost 1-0 to Lyon, second-bottom after four matchdays, ended a record five-defeat European run with 0-0 against Bodo/Glimt; Nianzou forced off injured.
strengths.away: Slow starters in this competition with a blunted attack; Luis Diaz set to return.

preview.author: Chris Wilson

pick.text: AS Roma have a scoring knack, but that's unlikely to be enough to beat PSG, so a home win and both teams to score seems a nice combination.

preview.synopsis: First meeting. PSG are heavy favourites at home. Writer picks a home win and both teams to score.

strengths.home: Won all four league phase games with 20 goals, a record for the first four matches; unbeaten in five home games against Italian clubs; Doue out for months.
strengths.away: Strong scoring record; Balerdi withdrawn injured.

preview.author: Matt Jones

pick.text: Fenerbahçe have long-standing travelling issues in the UCL, and with Shakhtar Donetsk holding a formidable record against Turkish opponents, backing a Shakhtar Donetsk win could be the best approach.

preview.synopsis: Shakhtar are unbeaten in two earlier meetings. Writer backs a Shakhtar win.

strengths.home: Winless in three (1-1 with Livyi Bereh, 0-1 against Sporting); four points from four; no fresh injuries; unbeaten in 11 against Turkish clubs.
strengths.away: Long-standing UCL travel issues; Ake likely missing.

preview.author: Ryan Fisher

pick.text: Only pre-round basement dwellers Slovan Bratislava have trailed for longer than United in this season’s UCL, which brings a Sporting CP half-time/full-time double into consideration.

preview.synopsis: Sporting have won one of four previous meetings (1964). Writer suggests a Sporting half-time/full-time double.

strengths.home: Five straight wins, the last two under new manager Paulo Fonseca; W3 L1 in the league phase; no new issues.
strengths.away: Unbeaten in 13 against Portuguese opposition; Cunha suspended; among the longest to trail this UCL season.
